description: Current conditions plus a 24-hour hourly forecast AND a 7-day daily outlook for any of Puerto Rico's 78 municipalities, by name or slug (e.g. 'San Juan', 'ponce', 'Río Grande'; accents optional). Hourly temperature (°F), wind (mph + direction) and conditions; daily high/low, rain chance and amount, peak wind, UV, sunrise/sunset — from Open-Meteo via 787daily's cached endpoint.
name: get_town_weather
